label: three house modes for one verse — precise, hype, beautiful. Any conversational agent explaining the verse renders in the mode the moment needs.

source.sanskrit: vyāptacarācarabhāvaviśeṣaṃ cinmayam ekam anantam anādim bhairavanātham anāthaśaraṇyaṃ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi vande

precise.desc: every proposition checkable against L1; slang only where glossary-mapped; zero decoration
precise.c2: No cap, He runs through literally everything — moving, still, all of it — pure consciousness, one, no beginning, no end. That's Bhairava the Lord — shelter for everyone with nowhere else to go. My mind's already His, so this bow isn't me asking for anything — it's me clocking what's already true, right here in my chest.

hype.desc: maximum energy, meaning locked; slang-dense but every term translated in-line; no filler transitions; completed-past for tvanmaya (was, not becoming)
hype.c2: Bro, He pervades literally every particular state of everything that moves and everything that stands still — living rent-free in all of it. And what He IS: consciousness-made, one, endless, beginningless. No end, no start, just pure awareness. That's Bhairava — the refuge for the helpless, shelter with zero backup, zero plan, zero flex. And my mind? Already His. Was before I opened my mouth. So this bow, right here in my heart — no cap, I'm not reaching. I'm just recognizing I never left.

prayer.desc: devotional tenderness first; slang softens, never jokes at the verse's expense; rasa forward
prayer.c2: like, you're already everywhere in the moving and the still — every particular state of being alive and being stone. Made of pure awareness, no edges, no starting point, just this. You're the refuge when you've got literally nothing left to hold. And honestly my mind is already Yours, already was before I opened my mouth — so this bow, right here in the heart, isn't an ask. It's just me, bowing because I already belong here.
